content.short: NFT-based blockchain accounting tool for on-chain invoicing, payments, payroll, and account management.
content.description: Bulla Network provides NFT-based accounting and finance tools tailored for web3 companies, DAOs, and individuals. Since its launch in 2021, there is no setup required—users simply connect their wallets to send invoices, make payments, and run payroll within the web3 environment. The protocol mints a token representing both sides of a future transaction on-chain, instantly updating the books for all parties in the Bulla dashboard and serving as a single source of truth for audits and account management. As a composable, open-source protocol, it can also function as a plug-in in a tech stack.
